newsitem.title: UK: ICI up after broker says "buy".
newsitem.headline: ICI up after broker says "buy".

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries jumped after brokerage Kleinwort Benson issued a short-term buy recommendation on the stock, traders said.
By 0850 GMT, the shares were up 17-1/2p to 826p, the highest level since mid-June.
Kleinwort Benson still maintains ICI on its long-term hold list, traders said.
Other factors contributing to the advance this morning included an advance in ICI's ADRs in the U.S. on Friday, traders said. They rose $3/4 to $50-5/8.
Trading in ICI's stock options also helped lift the shares, they said.
